name: Christian Beener
title: Full-Stack Developer & Entrepreneur
bioParagraphs: With a B.S. in Computer Information Systems from the University of Houston and years of full-stack experience, I founded cbeens.dev to solve a specific problem: the death of the fast web.
My background in system design and cloud infrastructure allows me to build "Sovereign Tech" for local Austin businesses who refuse to settle for bloated, slow-loading templates.
